scope: Development-only watermarked-positive sensitivity screen for the proposed v2 null design; not a confirmatory detection claim and not an attack result

provisional_thresholds.synthid_threshold_policy: one shared threshold per model x length, set to the maximum of ten key-specific calibration candidates
provisional_thresholds.caveat: The 5,000-sample source makes this a conservative stress test for the proposed 20,000-sample design; thresholds are development-only and cannot be carried into v2 confirmation.

screen.cell_definition: 2 schemes x 10 matched generation/detection keys x 3 prefix lengths
screen.global_rule: pass only if every one of the 60 explicitly named cells has at least 40 strict detections out of 50
screen.intervals: one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bounds reported descriptively without multiplicity adjustment
screen.pass_consequence: permits the final v2 protocol and compute-budget decision; does not authorize confirmation or attacks
screen.failure_consequence: reassess the 0.5% margin and detector-sensitivity trade-off before any v2 null generation
